text: A medieval legend says two green-skinned children appeared in an English village.
At harvest time, villagers found a brother and sister beside a wolf pit.
They spoke a language nobody knew.
For days they refused all food...
Slowly they learned to eat, and the green began to fade.
Sadly, the boy was sickly, and died around the time of his baptism.
and explained where they came from.
A land where the sun never shone, the light was like twilight...
Historians call it folklore, or a garbled real event.
So where did the green children come from?
